messages.content: 一輛汽車從靜止開始，10秒內行駛了120公尺的距離。在這段時間結束時，汽車的速度是多少？在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。在第二階段，汽車的加速度是多少？

function.name: kinematics_calculate_acceleration
function.description: Calculates the acceleration of an object under given conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to reach the final speed. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

function.name: kinematics_calculate_speed_from_rest
function.description: Calculates the speed of an object that starts from rest under a constant acceleration over a specified distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to travel. This is a float type value.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

We need to compute first part: car starts from rest, 10 seconds, distance 120 m. We need final speed after 10s. Assuming constant acceleration? It says "from rest, 10 seconds, distance 120 m". Usually constant acceleration. So use s = 0.5 a t^2. Solve a = 2s / t^2 = 2*120 / 100 = 240/100 = 2.4 m/s^2. Final speed v = a t = 2.4*10 = 24 m/s. So first part speed = 24 m/s.

Second part: after reaching this speed, car continues accelerating for 5 seconds, from 12 m/s to final speed which is twice the initial speed of this second stage? Wait: "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" Means starting speed 12 m/s, final speed is twice the initial speed (so 24 m/s). But earlier we had 24 m/s as speed after first part. But second part says starting speed 12 m/s? That seems inconsistent. Let's parse: "在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。" Wait: maybe misinterpretation: After reaching this speed (24 m/s), the car continues accelerating for 5 seconds, from 12 m/s to final speed that is twice the initial speed. But initial speed of second stage is 12 m/s? That would mean the car slowed down? That doesn't make sense. Maybe the problem statement: "在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。" Actually maybe they mean: After the first part, the car continues accelerating for 5 seconds, starting from 12 m/s, and ends at a speed that is twice the initial speed of that second stage. And that final speed is twice the speed computed in the first part. So first part speed = 24 m/s. Final speed after second stage = 2 * 24 = 48 m/s. Starting speed of second stage = 12 m/s. So acceleration over 5 seconds from 12 to 48 m/s. So acceleration a = (v - u)/t = (48 - 12)/5 = 36/5 = 7.2 m/s^2. That seems plausible.

But check: "最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍" yes final speed = 2 * 24 = 48 m/s. Good.

Thus answer: first part speed 24 m/s. Second part acceleration 7.2 m/s^2.
